help.title: Backup types
help.summary: In short: Back up now to return to an earlier state on this computer; Full backup before you reset or replace the computer.
help.manual: Taken with Back up now. A copy of this computer's memories, workspace files and Claude settings at that moment, kept in the backup folder. If something goes wrong, Restore this backup takes you back to that moment. If the computer is reset, it is erased with it.
help.daily: The same copy, taken automatically every day at the time you set. The last 30 are kept; if nothing changed, no new file is written.
help.before: Taken automatically before every import, restore and undo. Undo in History uses these backups.
help.full: Taken with Full backup, before you reset or replace the computer. Besides the memories, the app's settings, version history, activity log and every backup go into one file. Keep it off the computer; opening it on a fresh install continues where you left off.
help.export: Made in Transfer → Create bundle, for another device. Only the memories and workspaces you pick go in, and the other device merges them both ways.

full.title: Full backup before resetting the computer
full.intro: Besides memories, workspace files and Claude settings, the app's settings, version history, matches, activity log and every backup taken so far go into one file. After the reset, install the app and open this file: everything goes back where it was and the app continues where it left off.

about.sub: Moves and backs up Claude Code memories, workspace files and Claude settings between devices, without losing anything.
